_readme: Crew requests (CrewRequests, src/levels/crew_requests.gd): each mission Hana and Mira ask for one thing. Wording is Faiq's to rewrite; conditions are Fahd's.
radio: the subtitle line played once at mission start (after that mission's mission_started lines). summary: the short line in the console's Mission tab and the report.

condition.kind: max_slope (value: degrees, steepest slope driven), dock_battery_min (value: charge fraction on docking, no emergency recovery), objective_done (objective), no_recoveries, thermal_pair (sun and shade ground temperatures).
met / missed: the report's reason. Placeholders: {slope} {limit} {charge} {recoveries} {sun} {shade} {missing}. dock_battery_min also uses missed_recovery and missed_not_docked.
lines: extra radio lines for that mission's start, after the requests. planning_notes: shown beside a cargo item in the Planning tab.

requests.speaker: Hana
requests.radio: Easy on the slopes out there. Kite's mast camera hasn't been aligned since Evan left, and I want a clean look at that panel.
requests.summary: Keep the drive gentle: no slope over 15°

requests.speaker: Mira
requests.radio: One thing from me: bring Kite back with at least half its battery. I want to know what margin we really have.
requests.summary: Dock Kite with at least 50% battery
requests.missed_recovery: Kite came home on an emergency recovery.
requests.missed_not_docked: Kite never docked on its own.

requests.speaker: Hana
requests.radio: If there's room on the manifest, take the sampling kit. Nobody has sampled the patch by IRIS yet.
requests.met: The near-site sample came home with Kite.

requests.speaker: Mira
requests.radio: Twelve kilograms changes how Kite handles. Take it steady: no emergency recoveries this mission.
requests.met: Kite came home on its own.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: And for M3: I'll want ground temperatures, sun and shade. The thermal turret is worth the mass if the lander has room.

requests.speaker: Hana
requests.radio: While you're out at the rim, take two ground temperatures with the thermal turret: one in sunlight, one in shade.
requests.summary: Take both ground temperatures, sun and shade

requests.speaker: Mira
requests.radio: The far rim is the longest drive yet. Dock with at least a quarter of the battery left, please.
requests.summary: Dock Kite with at least 25% battery
requests.missed_recovery: Kite came home on an emergency recovery.
requests.missed_not_docked: Kite never docked on its own.

planning_notes.thermal_turret: Hana: needed for M3 ground temperatures
